loss: GT-Mean L1 + fft_loss_weight * complex FFT L1 on raw RGB
image_policy: train: paired random crop 128x128, paired uniform D4; val/infer: whole image; train saturation p=0.25, factor range=[0.9, 1.1]
val_policy: image-equal raw L1 and clamped RGB float PSNR (MSE floor 1e-12); no GT mean; best_val.pt selected by minimum raw L1
resume_policy: exact epoch/batch shuffle and saved RNG; backend bitwise determinism not guaranteed
saturation_policy: train only; same factor for LQ/GT; val/test unchanged
initialization: build complete V2 under seed100 first; preserve every V2 tensor; initialize only added candidate layers afterwards
d4_batch_policy: shared 90-degree rotation bit; independent image horizontal/vertical flips
star_recipe: zero original complete StarBlocks, zero StarModules and zero DFFNs in the instantiated model

wavelet_recipe.transform: two-level fixed orthonormal Haar; FP32; replicate padding and original-size cropping
wavelet_recipe.low_processing: LL2 only: concat channel-normalized LL2 with raw per-channel spatial mean and sqrt(var+1e-6); PW(3C,2C) -> DW5(2C) -> GELU -> PW(2C,2C); gain=exp(tanh(log_gain)); LL2_new=gain*LL2+bias
wavelet_recipe.low_initialization: affine head weight/bias zero: gain one and bias zero; full gradient flow, statistics never detached
wavelet_recipe.high_processing: each level uses three independent signed H_i+DW3_i(H_i) updates; depthwise weights zero and no bias; no LL-to-high gate or high attention in these fusion modules
wavelet_recipe.fine_low: coarse IDWT reconstructs LL1; fine mixer passes that LL1 through without another low head
wavelet_recipe.frequency: W(Z) is A's full two-level Haar reconstruction on the current working feature Z
wavelet_recipe.mdta: unchanged existing subband MDTA implementation; two independently weighted modules in R2/R3, preserve existing M1 and initialize only M2; same initial tensors in R2 and R3
wavelet_recipe.supervision: GT-Mean L1(sigma=0.1) + 0.1 complex FFT L1 on raw RGB; no RGB L1 or LL auxiliary loss
wavelet_recipe.quality_status: untrained candidate; synthetic implementation checks only
wavelet_recipe.component_provenance: A's own Haar/LL-affine fusion, NAFNet-inspired spatial gate and simple FFN, existing subband MDTA adaptation
wavelet_recipe.star_blocks: zero original complete StarBlocks, zero StarModules and zero DFFNs in the instantiated model
wavelet_recipe.initialization: build complete V2 under seed100 first; preserve every V2 tensor; initialize only added candidate layers afterwards
wavelet_recipe.second_update: A's unchanged pointwise gated FFN: PW(C,2C), split, multiplication, PW(C,C); no DW/GELU/window FFT
wavelet_recipe.residual_scales: A spatial scale1/scale2 reused; both per-channel learnable init0.1; scale1 applied once to the complete joint update, no independent frequency-only alpha

decoder_frequency_order.decoder1: fuse1 -> own decoder1 -> own former-star decoder1
decoder_frequency_order.decoder0: fuse0 -> own decoder0 -> own former-star decoder0

wavelet_recipe.second_mdta_initialization: fresh MDTAResidual(C=96,heads=4,LayerNorm2d), wrapped by the unchanged WaveletMDTAResidual; independent tensors; not tied or copied weights

decoder_frequency_order.decoder1: fuse1 -> own decoder1 -> own former-star decoder1
decoder_frequency_order.decoder0: fuse0 -> own decoder0 -> own former-star decoder0

gt_mean_gain: GT gray mean / prediction gray mean; differentiable
gt_mean_guard: raw L1 fallback for either gray mean <= 1e-6
gt_mean_precision: FP32; GT mean used only in training loss

fft_loss_recipe.representation: real and imaginary components; equivalent to stack(..., dim=-1)
fft_loss_recipe.reduction: mean over batch, RGB, both spatial frequency axes, real/imaginary axis
fft_loss_recipe.prediction: raw unclamped encoded RGB; no GT-Mean alignment
fft_loss_recipe.frequency_scope: all frequencies, including DC; no low-frequency mask

fft_alignment: raw prediction and GT; no GT-Mean alignment in FFT term
